instruction: Create a filter in Thunderbird to automatically forward every incoming email at anonym-x2024@outlook.com to personal-archive@yahoo.com. Set this up locally in Thunderbird without touching the online account.

metadata.explanation: Variation with different forward target email (personal-archive@yahoo.com). Evaluator verifies filter is enabled, action is Forward, target is personal-archive@yahoo.com, and condition is ALL. Same complexity as original.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts Thunderbird filter rules file from the VM at the correct path for the outlook.office365.com account
Metric correctly parses the msgFilterRules.dat file format and checks all required filter attributes (enabled, action, actionValue, condition)

Complete coverage: all instruction requirements are verified - forward action (action='Forward'), target email (actionValue='personal-archive@yahoo.com'), applies to all incoming emails (condition=['ALL']), and filter is enabled (enabled='yes')
Data flow is correct: getter returns file path (str) which metric expects as result parameter

Expected values are semantically correct for the task - enabled='yes' ensures filter is active, action='Forward' is correct for forwarding, actionValue matches the target email from instruction, condition=['ALL'] correctly matches 'every incoming email'
Postconfig appropriately closes Message Filters window to ensure filter is saved before file extraction, with sleep to allow file write
Logic will work correctly at runtime - the filter file path is valid for the configured Thunderbird profile, and the metric parsing logic correctly handles the Thunderbird filter file format

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_filter first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
